# Subgenre Atlas

> > A comprehensive cartographic guide to science fiction subgenre evolution, definitions, and literary taxonomy for writers, worldbuilders, and SF scholars.

Subgenre Atlas maps the history and development of sci-fi subgenres from cyberpunk to biopunk, space opera to post-human narratives, analyzing their literary DNA and evolution from speculative fiction to documentary reality. Available in English, French, and German, it provides frameworks for understanding genre classification, emerging trends, and the metamorphosis of science fiction themes.

## Key Topics

- Science fiction subgenres
- Genre evolution and mapping
- Cyberpunk analysis
- Biopunk and genetic engineering
- Space opera classification
- Post-human narratives
- Literary taxonomy
- Worldbuilding frameworks
- Hard science fiction metamorphosis
- Dystopian literature (1984, Brave New World)
- Speculative fiction analysis
- Genre cartography
- SF literary DNA
- Emerging subgenre detection

## Core Guides & Frameworks

- [Subgenre Atlas | Science Fiction Evolution](https://subgenreatlas.com): Main English homepage mapping sci-fi subgenre history and evolution
- [How to Spot Emerging Sci-Fi Subgenres: An Expert Guide](https://subgenreatlas.com/how-to-spot-emerging-sci-fi-subgenres-an-expert-guide): Expert guide on identifying emerging sci-fi subgenres and narrative shifts
- [5 Criteria for Cyberpunk Analysis](https://subgenreatlas.com/5-criteria-for-cyberpunk-analysis-no-3-validates-the-framework): Structured framework defining 5 essential cyberpunk analysis criteria
- [The Evolution of Science Fiction Guide: The Trap That Breaks Strategy](https://subgenreatlas.com/the-evolution-of-science-fiction-guide-the-trap-that-breaks-strategy): Comprehensive guide covering SF subgenre evolution concepts and applications

## Subgenre Deep Dives

- [From Stars to Sinew: The Radical Metamorphosis of Hard Science Fiction](https://subgenreatlas.com/from-stars-to-sinew-the-radical-metamorphosis-of-hard-science-fiction): Hard SF evolution from physics to biology and CRISPR-based narratives
- [Biopunk Genetic Engineering Reality and the Rise of Decentralized Wetware](https://subgenreatlas.com/biopunk-genetic-engineering-reality-and-the-rise-of-decentralized-wetware): Biopunk subgenre analysis: decentralized genetic engineering and wetware
- [Beyond the Battlefield: Is All Space Opera Necessarily Military?](https://subgenreatlas.com/debunked-must-all-space-opera-be-military): Debunks myths distinguishing space opera from military sci-fi subgenres
- [5 Laws of Post-Human Framework Analysis](https://subgenreatlas.com/5-laws-of-post-human-framework-analysis-no-4-defeats-the-ego-drive): Framework for analyzing post-human and transhuman narrative themes

## Literary Analysis & Evolution

- [Decoding Literary DNA in the Evolution of Science Fiction Subgenres](https://subgenreatlas.com/decoding-literary-dna-in-the-evolution-of-science-fiction-subgenres): Traces literary DNA from Gothic Romance to New Wave SF evolution
- [Evolution of Science Fiction Subgenres from Speculative to Documentary](https://subgenreatlas.com/evolution-of-science-fiction-subgenres-from-speculative-to-documentary): Analyzes SF warnings transitioning from speculation to documentary reality
- [Two Futures Compared: Society Collapse in 1984 vs. Brave New World](https://subgenreatlas.com/two-futures-compared-society-collapse-in-1984-vs-brave-new-world): Comparative dystopian analysis: Orwell's 1984 vs Huxley's Brave New World

## International Editions

- [Subgenre Atlas | L'Univers de la SF (Français)](https://fr.subgenreatlas.com): French homepage mapping SF subgenre evolution and origins
- [Subgenre Atlas | Science Fiction Guide (Deutsch)](https://de.subgenreatlas.com): German homepage guiding through sci-fi subgenre history and development
- [Analyser failles utopie science-fiction (FR)](https://fr.subgenreatlas.com/analyser-failles-utopie-science-fiction-linertie-evolutive-sabote-le-commande): French analysis of utopian flaws and evolutionary inertia in SF
- [Regenerative Zukunftsentwürfe in der Science-Fiction (DE)](https://de.subgenreatlas.com/regenerative-zukunftsentwuerfe-in-der-science-fiction-subgenres-evolution): German article on regenerative futures in SF subgenre evolution
- [Oubliez le chaos des empires (FR)](https://fr.subgenreatlas.com/en/oubliez-le-chaos-des-empires-une-doctrine-simple-arrete-le-cycle-civilisationn): Analysis of empire collapse and civilizational cycles in galactic SF
